fusions.name: End of the Stalk
fusions.desc: A raking strike that deals 26 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Catch and Release
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Rakes your claws through a cone 3 tiles long for 9 damage, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Slink
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Always Lands Right
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
